checkpoint_finding.declared_corpus: ENCODE/Roadmap/Xpresso-derived sequence, DNase, H3K27ac, Hi-C, RNA/CAGE and ABC candidates for six cell lines; selected weights are HepG2 RNA f3

interpretation: EPInformer is potentially useful as a compact enhancer-to-gene prior, but the selected HepG2 f3 release is neither MASLD-contextual nor a signed variant-effect model. Its eligible score is relative attention within a fixed native candidate set. GSE289173 target labels appear unexposed, yet the comparator is currently unschedulable because exact-code licensing, safe loading, fold routing, and native HepG2 input files remain unresolved.
known_incidents_and_biases: The Nature Communications code-availability statement says v0.1.1 is MIT, but no LICENSE/COPYING/NOTICE file exists in that tag or the selected later code commit. The current Zenodo concept record is v0.3.0 with CC-BY-4.0 metadata, not the selected commit. Exact-code terms remain unresolved.
The Hugging Face model card declares MIT for weights, but weight terms do not independently authorize reuse of unlicensed source code.
The model card usage text names JiecongLin/EPInformer-pipeline, while the exact inspected repository is JiecongLin/EPInformer.
The official loader calls torch.load with weights_only=False on pickle-based .pt files.
The expression checkpoint requires its matching fold-specific enhancer encoder and a separate native HDF5/feature/split authority; checkpoint bytes alone are insufficient.
Attention is normalized within each promoter's candidate set. Changing the TSS, candidate enhancers, order, activity, contact, or missingness changes the score denominator.
HepG2 is a transformed cell line and its activity/contact context is not a substitute for MASLD donor or cell-state context.
Averaging all twelve chromosome-fold models would include models trained on the queried chromosome; the out-of-fold lane must route by the exact frozen split instead.
Attention is unsigned and cannot distinguish activating from repressive links or infer an allele-specific gene-expression direction.
remaining_blockers: Obtain an explicit upstream license covering the exact selected code commit or written permission. Until then, do not download weights, execute, adapt, or redistribute the code.

Pass L40S import/load/forward, no-network, deterministic attention, chromosome routing, padding mask, candidate-order, reverse-complement/strand, and cross-device tolerance probes.

Freeze the static HepG2 link atlas and interval-overlap evaluator before sealed inference. Keep any sequence substitution, activity delta, cell-state transfer, or link-plus-direction composite outside this link-only checkpoint record.
